description: Resolve a product description (any of 10 languages, e.g. 'vegan sunscreen', '컵라면', 'kimchi', 'キムチ', '3304') to one of the 35 HS4 items TradeGraph covers, or to the usual HS4 code of ~60 other common consumer products (kimchi 2005, shampoo 3305, candy 1704, ginseng roots 1211, ginseng extract 1302…) that gtm_plan and market_scan take with live UN Comtrade data. Ingredient words alone (ginseng, vitamin, collagen) do not decide the item: 'ginseng cream' is cosmetics 3304, 'ginseng shampoo' hair care 3305. For ginseng the answer adds hs_by_form (roots, extract, mixed preparations, drinks); for electric beauty devices it adds hs_by_form too (LED masks and microcurrent 8543.70, vibrating massagers 9019.10, hair stylers 8516). Use before other tools when unsure of the HS code.

query.description: Product name, alias or HS digits.
